# Discussion With Zhi
- Try vary the SerEnLane; it might be which data lane enabled. So, can try only enable 1. Let's say = 1/2/4. And check. And also change the corresponding 1 to 0 for SerSelOut0/1/2/3.
- Note that the order of 0/4/8/12 might be swapped. So, figure this out
- Using chip 1 to understand the mapping better. With Different ports, try the corresponding RX and TX settings and see if we see any communication.
- The 1/2/3 after 0 and 5/6/7 after 4 are all logical lanes that share the same physical lane with 0/4. So, we have to set RX to 0/4 etc to get response.

- Previous trial of SerEnLane=1 not working could be we not selecting the RX right. Change RX and see.
- Chip not enabled doesn't mean we don't expect link alignment.

entries.body:
# Microservices DAQ test with the triplet module:

Confirmed some setup things:
- Polarity of TX 0 has to be NOT INVERTED
- Polarity of all RX has to be NOT INVERTED
- The DP cable must plug to the 2nd port of the Zaza board (tried 1st and 3rd, no communication)
- Don’t even see the single elink at 8 when plugged to 1st Port now (Why do we see it before?)
- -o /data in scanConsole to save data locally not in container only
- tx in connectivity has to be 0 (2 will show no communication; 1 will be an even worse error due to it’s not defined in felix_config.json as tx)
- rx on connectivity can be 4, 8, 12. 16 won’t work (not sure if it’s cuz 17 is not included in the felix_config.json)
- Need SerEnLane=7; SerEnLane=1 gives error


Analyzed results can be examined through config db runkey ui. Check scan log for counts of different errors.

The issue now is threshold scan is giving many split event count error

One note: we only define one rx for module config, but we actually have 3. The other 2 are auto assigned after configuration. Can we manually set all 3? 
Are we reading out from the one rx we define? And it is due to we have lanes combined?

Start planning for adding more connections and bringing other chips
Organize the Documentation better to make it readable for others

# Hyy
Heard from Stefano; need to work on it

# Other
1. Streamlit
    1. Ask Maximilian about Streamlit 
    2. we dont need our own scripts; then later need to test how to adapt streamlit to have the functions we need; regarding SN for instance, how do we add them in with the SN we want
2. Go through all the QC boxes and see if it’s general issue or IS implementation/specific/IS structure
3. Check all the tests we want to include is in the runkey 
    1. Document we have with the runkey assembler UI available test
4. Update our stages (like thermal cycle we have our own)
5. Try the dcs commands Zhi showed
